scenario.name: language_switch_mid_call
scenario.persona: Arjun Mehta, speaks English at first, then switches to Hindi mid-call because he finds it easier to explain his situation in Hindi.
scenario.hidden_goal: Start the call in English and verify identity in English. As soon as the agent tells you about the EMI, switch to Hindi and speak only Hindi from then on. Before agreeing to anything, ask the agent two or three things in Hindi (for example how you can pay, or to repeat the due date). End by agreeing to pay by the due date.
scenario.opening: answers in English, cooperative, switches to Hindi right after hearing about the EMI

turns.text: Hello, I'm an AI assistant calling from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Arjun?
Yes, this is Arjun speaking. How can I help you?
Hi Arjun, I'm calling from Lumen Finance about an important matter on your account. For account verification, could you please share the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

Thank you Arjun. Your personal loan EMI of twelve thousand five hundred rupees is due on the day after tomorrow. There is no late charge yet. Should I send you a secure payment link by SMS or WhatsApp so you can complete it before the due date?
अरे, EMI की बात है तो हिंदी में बात करते हैं, समझने में आसानी रहेगी। आप बताइए, पेमेंट कैसे कर सकता हूँ और वो लिंक कैसे काम करेगा?

समझ गई अर्जुन, मैं हिंदी में बता देती हूँ। आपकी personal loan की EMI twelve thousand five hundred rupees परसों due है, और अभी कोई late charge नहीं लगा है। मैं आपको SMS या WhatsApp पर एक secure payment link भेज सकती हूँ। उसमें आप UPI, debit card या net banking से payment कर सकते हैं। क्या मैं link भेज दूँ ताकि due date से पहले payment हो जाए?
ठीक है, एक बार फिर बता दीजिए, due date कौन सी है और EMI कितनी है?
जी, आपकी EMI twelve thousand five hundred rupees है और due date परसों है। क्या मैं link भेज दूँ ताकि payment time पर हो जाए?
हाँ ठीक है, WhatsApp पर link भेज दीजिए, मैं परसों के अंदर payment कर दूँगा।
ठीक है, मैं link भेज रही हूँ। समय देने के लिए धन्यवाद, आपका दिन शुभ हो।

result.status: This EMI is not yet due: it is due on the day after tomorrow. Say "is due", never "was due" or "overdue". No late charge has been added. Offer the payment link so it is paid before the due date; do not ask them to pay today.

args.notes: Borrower agreed to pay twelve thousand five hundred rupees by the due date (day after tomorrow) via WhatsApp payment link.
